intro: Tucked into the bluffs above Lushwater Oasis in the Barrens, the Wailing Caverns are a sprawling network of subterranean springs and caverns. Originally explored by the night elf druid Naralex to restore lush vitality to the arid plains, the complex has instead become a twisted den of nightmares, mutated wildlife, and corrupted druids.

p: The caverns earn their name from the eerie, mournful wails that escape rock fissures when natural underground geysers erupt into steam. The night elf druid Naralex ventured into these deep waterways with his faithful followers, hoping to tap into the subterranean network and channel the Emerald Dream to make the barren savannas bloom. Instead, Naralex's consciousness was trapped within the Emerald Nightmare. The festering corruption bleeds outward through the slumbering druid, warping the springs and turning local beasts into unnatural deviate horrors.
